# Scrape Do

Scrape.do is a web scraping API offering rotating residential, data-center, and mobile proxies with headless browser support and session management to bypass anti-bot protections (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai) and extract data at scale in formats like JSON and HTML.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scrape-do/.

## Actions

- **Block specific URLs during scraping**: This tool allows users to block specific urls during the scraping process.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieves account information and usage statistics from scrape.do.
- **Get rendered page content** (read-only): This tool allows you to scrape web pages with javascript rendering enabled.
- **Monitor WebSocket requests using scrape.do** (read-only): This tool provides the ability to view websocket requests made by a webpage.
- **Scrape webpage using scrape.do** (read-only): A tool to scrape web pages using scrape.do's api service.
- **Set Cookies for Scraping**: This tool allows users to set specific cookies for their scraping requests to a target website.
- **Set custom headers for scrape.do request** (read-only): A tool to send custom headers with scrape.do requests.
- **Set Custom Wait Time**: This tool sets the custom wait time in milliseconds after page load when using the render option in scrape.do.
- **Set Device Type for Scraping** (read-only): This tool allows users to set the device type (desktop, mobile, or tablet) for making scraping requests.
- **Set Disable Redirection**: Controls the automatic redirection behavior of scrape.do requests.
- **Set Pure Cookies Mode**: This tool enables getting the original set-cookie headers from target websites instead of the processed scrape.do-cookies format.
- **Set Regional Geolocation for Scraping** (read-only): This tool allows users to set a broader geographical targeting by specifying a region code instead of a specific country code.
- **Set Retry Timeout**: This tool allows users to set the maximum wait time (in milliseconds) before retrying a failed request in scrape.do.

- **Use Scrape.do Proxy Mode** (read-only): This tool implements the proxy mode functionality of scrape.do, which allows routing requests through their proxy server.
